title: TRAnscutaneous vaGUS Nerve Stimulation in Patients With Chronic Heart Failure
official: TRAnscutaneous vaGUS Nerve Stimulation in Patients With Chronic Heart Failure
summary: To verify the efficacy of transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation (tVNS) on and autonomic balance in patients with chronic heart failure and reduced (HFrEF) or mildly reduced (HFmrEF) left ventricular ejection fraction. The study hypothesis is that tVNS increases baroreflex gain, with consequent benefits on sympathovagal balance (at short- and mid-term), and on quality of life and bio-humoral parameters (at mid-term).
conditions: Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
Heart Failure With Midrange Ejection Fraction
